execution_constraints: The GitHub Actions job must declare this exact image including the sha256 digest; a mutable tag alone is forbidden.
No setup-java action, apt install, SDKMAN install, package upgrade or dynamic tool installation may mutate the execution toolchain before capture.
The capture must hash the actual java, python3, bash and git executables visible inside the container before any build/test launch.
The capture must record /etc/os-release, uname facts, architecture, mount table and the GitHub host/runner metadata that are observable from inside the container.
The capture must reject JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS, _JAVA_OPTIONS, CLASSPATH, PYTHONPATH, JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS.
The host kernel and GitHub runner are supplemental observed facts, not substitutes for the immutable container-image digest.
The workflow must use repository Gradle wrapper/build sources and may not install a different Gradle/JDK/Python.
next_gate: Implement the exact supplemental capture source/workflow against this digest-pinned container and independently review all capture bytes and fail-closed rules before dispatch.
